summary: The old debt comes to the door: {creditor} is owed money from a business of yours that failed, and you are now a candidate.
realLife: One life: His clothing store failed in the 1921 recession, and he did not pay off the last of its debts until 1935. Another: His New Salem store went into debt, and when his partner died he was left with what they owed.
gates: A business of yours failed with debts unpaid.
You are a candidate or hold office.
choices: agree to pay on a schedule
ask a friend with money for help
tell them to take it to court
ask them to wait until after the election

branches.when: a banker friend offers to cover it
branches.then: Taking it clears the debt and makes a debt of another kind.
They learn of it at the door, and the talk after is about trust.
